en.title: House Republicans vote to refer Hegseth impeachment to Judiciary Committee
en.dek: Republicans block effort to impeach Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth in chamber vote
facts: House Republicans voted 211 to 204 to refer Hegseth impeachment to Judiciary Committee
The vote effectively stopped the effort to impeach Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth
The motion was led by Republican members seeking impeachment charges
The vote fell along party lines with unified Republican opposition to the referral
body: House Republicans voted 211 to 204 to refer impeachment charges against Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth to the Republican-led House Judiciary Committee according to The Jerusalem Post.
This action effectively stopped the effort to impeach Hegseth, as the referral prevented the full House from voting on the articles of impeachment.
The Hindu reported that Republicans derailed the bid to impeach Hegseth in the chamber vote on Friday.
The vote fell along party lines with unified Republican opposition to referring the impeachment to the Judiciary Committee.
The development marks the latest turn in ongoing scrutiny of Defense Department leadership.
Republican members had pushed for the impeachment citing various grounds related to Hegseth's tenure.
The referral to committee means the impeachment effort will now proceed through standard judicial channels rather than a full House vote.
Democratic members opposed the effort, arguing against the impeachment charges.
The vote outcome reflects the current partisan balance in the House of Representatives.
en.context: House Republicans moved to refer impeachment charges against Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth to the Judiciary Committee, effectively blocking a full House vote on the articles of impeachment. The vote fell along party lines with unified Republican opposition to the referral while Democratic members opposed the effort.

en.headline: House Republicans vote 211 to 204 to refer Hegseth impeachment to Judiciary Committee
en.body: The chamber voted 211 to 204 in favor of a motion to refer the impeachment charges to the Republican-led House Judiciary Committee according to The Jerusalem Post. This action effectively stopped the effort to impeach Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth

es.headline: Republicanos de la Cámara votan 211 a 204 para remitir el juicio político de Hegseth al Comité Judicial
es.body: La cámara votó 211 a 204 a favor de una moción para remitir los cargos de juicio político al Comité Judicial de la Cámara, liderado por los republicanos, según The Jerusalem Post. Esta acción detuvo efectivamente el intento de destituir al Secretario de Defensa Pete Hegseth

fr.headline: Les Républicains de la Chambre votent 211 contre 204 pour renvoyer l'impeachment de Hegseth à la commission judiciaire
fr.body: La chambre a voté 211 contre 204 en faveur d'une motion renvoyant les charges d'impeachment à la commission judiciaire de la Chambre dirigée par les Républicains, selon The Jerusalem Post. Cette action a effectivement stoppé l'effort d'impeachment du secrétaire à la Défense Pete Hegseth

it.headline: I Repubblicani della Camera votano 211 a 204 per deferire l'impeachment di Hegseth al Comitato Giudiziario
it.body: La Camera ha votato 211 a 204 a favore di una mozione per deferire le accuse di impeachment al Comitato Giudiziario guidato dai Repubblicani, secondo The Jerusalem Post. Questa azione ha di fatto bloccato lo sforzo per l'impeachment del Segretario della Difesa Pete Hegseth

de.headline: Republikaner des Repräsentantenhauses stimmen mit 211 zu 204 über die Überweisung des Impeachments von Hegseth an den Justizausschuss
de.body: Das Plenum stimmte mit 211 zu 204 für einen Antrag, die Impeachmentschulden an den vom Republikanern geführten Justizausschuss des Repräsentantenhauses zu überweisen, wie The Jerusalem Post berichtete. Diese Maßnahme stoppte effektiv den Versuch, Verteidigungsminister Pete Hegseth abzusetzen.

pt.headline: Republicanos da Câmara votam 211 a 204 para remeter o impeachment de Hegseth para a Comissão de Justiça
pt.body: A câmara votou 211 a 204 a favor de uma moção para remeter as acusações de impeachment para a Comissão de Justiça da Câmara, liderada pelos Republicanos, segundo The Jerusalem Post. Esta ação impediu efetivamente o esforço para o impeachment do Secretário da Defesa Pete Hegseth

zh.headline: 众议院共和党以211票对204票投票将赫格塞斯弹劾案移交司法委员会
zh.body: 据《耶路撒冷邮报》报道，众议院以211票对204票投票通过了一项动议，将弹劾指控移交由共和党领导的众议院司法委员会。此举有效地阻止了弹劾国防部长皮特·赫格塞斯的努力

ja.headline: 下院共和党、ヘグセス氏の弾劾を司法委員会に付託する案を211対204で可決
ja.body: エルサレム・ポスト紙によると、下院は共和党主導の下院司法委員会に弾劾訴追を付託する動議を211対204で可決した。この措置により、国防長官ピート・ヘグセス氏の弾劾の動きは実質的に阻止された。

ko.headline: 하원 공화당, 헤그세스 탄핵안을 사법위원회에 회부하는 데 211대 204로 찬성
ko.body: 예루살렘 포스트에 따르면, 본회의는 공화당이 이끄는 하원 사법위원회에 탄핵 혐의를 회부하는 동의안에 211대 204로 찬성했다. 이 조치로 인해 국방장관 피트 헤그세스에 대한 탄핵 시도는 사실상 중단되었다.
